title: BigP3BCI Study I — 9x8 checkerboard/performance-based (13 healthy subjects)
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 13 healthy participants in Study I of the bigP3BCI collection. Participants used a P300-based brain-computer interface speller with a 9x8 character grid and a checkerboard, performance-based stimulus paradigm. Data were recorded from 16 EEG channels at 256 Hz and annotated with Target and NonTarget events. The dataset is a BIDS-formatted derivative of the PhysioNet bigP3BCI release.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from 16 channels using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) at 256 Hz, with electrodes placed in the standard 10-20 montage and a 60 Hz line frequency. Participants performed a calibration phase followed by online speller testing with feedback in a laboratory setting. Events were labeled as Target or NonTarget, with trials spanning 0-1.0 s after stimulus onset.
